channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Why the Houthi advance towards Yemen’s Marib, Taiz matters
item.description: Marib is home to Yemen's oil sector. Whoever controls it secures economic gains. Taiz's location makes it critical.

item.title: Temporary Hormuz solution deferred as Iran-Arab summit falls through
item.description: Saudi Arabia asked for the meeting to be postponed, but Tehran says it will continue to seek a regionally backed bill.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz talks postponed due to Yemen events, says Iran
item.description: Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei says Iran does not interfere in Yemeni affairs.

item.title: Yemen gov’t forces advance in Taiz as Houthis claim attack on Saudi Arabia
item.description: Yemeni government forces have advanced in western Taiz after successfully repelling a Houthi offensive.

item.title: Iran war reshapes Brics ties but also exposes divisions
item.description: Brics members agree they need a new global order but it's harder to answer what should replace it and how to get there.

item.title: Watch: Why a Russian strike on train near Ukraine-Poland border could mark an escalation
item.description: No casualties were reported after a Russian drone struck a train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials left the area.

item.title: How global trade and oil prices could be hit by Houthi advance
item.description: Yemen's Houthis have seized territory near the Bab al-Mandab Strait - a key trade gateway for oil and global shipping.
